command: async (page) => await page.evaluate(async()=>{ const r=await fetch("/api/roster/team_nexus"); const d=await r.json(); return {status:r.status,keys:Object.keys(d),players:(Array.isArray(d)?d:d.players||d.roster||[]).map(x=>({id:x.id,name:x.name,stamina:x.stamina,dev_focus:x.dev_focus,training_intensity:x.training_intensity,streaming_commitment:x.streaming_commitment,streaming_pct:x.streaming_pct}))}; })
